Lots of new faces lately on the Capitol beat. Great to have fresh takes and new questions. Like I tell everyone starting out, know what you're stepping into: a rich and storied legacy of near two centuries of press. To catch up to speed, read this book by Don Ritchie:

Honestly, no one has as much fun news reporting as me. Even when I was in utter poverty, I had a blast. Now I'm getting the gear I always dreamt of wielding as the best on the beat. Can't thank y'all enough for joining me on this journey.


Pablo Manríquez (@PabloReports)

Professional News – Starting next week, two things: 

1. I'm gonna start live streaming votes to IG from my Meta glasses here: instagram.com/pablo.manrique…

2. My 1976 Pentax K1000 will begin joining me on the beat. BIG thank

Rep. Monica De La Cruz voted to triple ICE's budget. Then it came for the mariachi kids she'd paraded around Washington. Reporting by me: migrantinsider.com/p/she-funded...

SCOOP: ICE Moves to Hike Deportation Stay Fee by 387 Percent  (by Pablo Manríquez). The agency hasn’t touched the fee since 1989. Now it wants to charge $755 to people with final removal orders — many of them sick, broke, or both.

Senate Parliamentarian Kills Core of Republicans' ICE Funding Package (by Pablo Manríquez). Senate rulekeeper strips CBP appropriations and $2.5B DHS fund, citing conflicts with child protection laws — and the Trump administration's own record.

USCIS Rewrites the Rules on Deferred Action — and Immigrant Children Pay the Price (by Pablo Manríquez). A sweeping rewrite of federal deferred action rules ends automatic deportation relief for 200,000 Special Immigrant Juveniles — and hands officers broad new grounds to deny

The Man Who Built the Cages Now Runs the Agency (by Pablo Manríquez). David Venturella spent a decade at GEO Group. Now he's acting ICE director. For migrant communities, that's not a coincidence — it's the point.

Stephen Miller Lied About Migrant Jobs Going to American Workers (by Pablo Manríquez). Stephen Miller's broken promise that mass deportations would equal jobs for gringo workers is now peer-reviewed. Removing migrants actually lost jobs for the native born workforce.

The ICE Alert System No App Store Can Kill (by Logan Johnson). Sherman Austin built STOPICE.net to put real-time ICE alerts in half a million phones — no download required, no data collected, no off switch for the feds.
ICE Is Coming to the World Cup. (by Pablo Manríquez). What happens when the world's biggest sporting event lands in America's most aggressive immigration enforcement era?
Ex-ICE Deputy Loses House GOP Primary in Ohio (by Pablo Manríquez). Madison Sheahan failed to impress GOP voters with her banter about mass deportations and working for Kristi Noem.
Grassley Just Handed ICE $38 Billion. Here's the Fine Print. (by Pablo Manríquez). Senate Judiciary Committee language would fund migrant mass removal machine through 2029.

State Dept. Quietly Rewrites the Visa Interview (by Pablo Manríquez). A worldwide cable mandates two new questions that could bar persecution survivors from ever boarding a plane to the U.S. — before they set foot on American soil.
House Republicans Advance Two-Track Plan to Supercharge ICE Funding (Again) (by Pablo Manríquez). Budget framework unlocks $70 billion for enforcement; plus separate funding vote to re-open DHS.

Supreme Court Signals It May Let Trump Kill TPS for Haitians and Syrians — With Barely a Look at the Evidence (by Pablo Manríquez). Watch now | Conservative justices lean toward giving DHS unchecked power to terminate humanitarian protections.

Stephen Miller's Border Blueprint Gets Shredded in Federal Court (by Pablo Manríquez). A D.C. Circuit panel rules Trump’s asylum ban is unlawful, dealing a major blow to the administration’s most aggressive immigration gambit.

Congress Is About to Vote on $140 Billion for ICE. Nobody Knows Where the Last $100 Billion Went. (by Pablo Manríquez). DHS stopped reporting spending data when the shutdown began. Now Republicans are moving to appropriate more — without a public accounting of what's already been spent.

"ICE Works For me" — Now She's On Leave (by Pablo Manríquez). Watch now | A government contractor filed an OIG complaint against a 29-year-old deputy assistant secretary for counterterrorism at DHS. Congress has questions.
ACLU's Maribel Hernández Rivera:  La Constitución define Americano, no el presidente.

Jessica Craven discusses the importance of birthright citizenship outside the Supreme Court, emphasizing that individuals born in the United States belong here. She expresses her support for those who question their place, reinforcing the principles of the 14th amendment. This discussion provides a compelling perspective on constitutional law and us citizenship.
In case anyone here is interested in my art making. Otherwise I'll just post news. Nbd
Christian Maldonado joined ACLU outside of the Supreme Court on Wednesday where the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in the birthright citizenship case Barbara v Trump.
ACLU's Anthony Romero describe the vibe in the Supreme Court when Trump came to sit in on the birthright citizenship oral arguments on Wednesday.
Kathleen Martinez in front of the Supreme Court on Wednesday during the oral arguments in the birthright citrizenship case, Barbara v Trump.
Maxsim Borisov was released this week from ICE detention. Here he tells me about the challenges he faced as a gay man inside the Eloy Detention Center #

CAPITOL HILL — Rep. Dan Goldman (D-NY) on his new bill with Rep. Delia Ramirez and Sen. Catherine Cortes Masto to claw back the exorbitant fees the Trump admin now charges unaccompanied migrant CHILDREN to apply for status in the U.S.
Rep. Brad Johnson reacts to how Speaker Mike Johnson refusing to have Adelita Grijalva sworn in
Icymi, @migrantinsider asked Speaker Mike Johnson about the Bad Bunny Super Bowl. It got awkward.
